Or air tight, so there’s nowhere for the smell to escape. So it’s just, it’s just kind of spreading, like, in this kind of invisible--

Sort of, stench that fills up the carriage. I tell you, people’s eyes were bleeding, you know what I mean? It was like that’s how bad- it was just- it was unbelievable. I felt like my face was melting like that bit at the end of “Raiders…

To the tribe of the bloke who he killed and ate. So five pigs apparently made up for the fact that they'd killed one of them. They said, "Well, hang on, what are you gonna, what are you gonna do with this bloke's wife?"

Was it- you have to tick points?

--"with....pictures of CATS, painted on them". I've brought them in.
They are the most grotesque things.

He probably is wearing a beard. He plays... We can't say too much about it... He's playing a pirate I think.
Ooh he'd make a good pirate.

"What am I having for tea? I'll probably have spaghetti Bolognese tonight dad." "Oh yeah" "What have you had dad?" "Ah your mother just made a lovely lasagne Steve"
I mean it literally, that's the conversation, its like yeah, every parent they're just interested in food. Food that you've eaten, food you're planning to eat, food you've enjoyed in the past.

ex: Utterly mental and- and they've taken now to- they must be sort of 80 a piece and that is quite an old age, but they're fairly good health relatively speaking and uhm, they just spend their time in bed. I mean, that's all they do is- that-…
I tell you what they're like, they're like that old- got- they're like that old family in Charlie and the Chocolate Factory.
Remember how none of them had got up--

ex: So the problem is that they have to get up. They get up at 7:00 in the morning to put on say, you know, some beef or lamb whichever they're going to cook. They put it on at 6:00 in the morning, 7:00 in the morning, so that by the time they…
You could suck it away. Who wants that from a roast dinner? You may as well blend it up--
And serve it as a broth.
I don't want that phrase coming from old people without teeth.

ex: Well, it's true. But it's just all this-- it's the same thing. It's the leeches in a blender. It's the fella looking at an electron. It's the mouse with an ear on its back. I don't know what the point is.
But you don't read on! Because I've seen you read somewhere and you're going "Look at that! Man survives on eating knee." And I go "what else?" And you go "I didn't read on"
You look at the mouse with the ear on the back and you just think "That must be murder at a concert!" You don't think!
I just think, is it worth sort of wasting all the
You think he swallowed someone's ear. He gnawed it away and swallowed it, and it's just in his system.

What a platform! It's good, you know. We've got a radio show, our own radio show. People are spending money to advertise it... People are actually bothering to listen. And the words of wisdom coming out your mouth is "Don't mess around…
No, but just going back to
You sound just like Bob Geldof.

q: Karl described a sense that warns him "This is dodgy" and tells him "We shouldn't be here". What did Steve ask if it was?

ex: I'm just having that other sense is like "This is dodgy."

Just that sense when I don't know why, but something's telling me: "We shouldn't be here". And you go: "Alright, let's go!" And you move from it. And you don't know what that is. You don't know what's decided that.
It's like when you lost. A part me brain's got me lost. But then there's another bit that I don't know what it is where they go: "Go left"!

But you didn’t – I – what do you mean I didn’t know?! You’re supposed to write it down, that’s the whole point, we’re writing things down!
YOU SAID WATER! YOU SAID WATER!
BUT THAT’S BECAUSE I THOUGHT WE WEREN’T TAKIN’ THE QUESTION SERIOUSLY, ‘CAUSE HE DIDN’T KNOW WHAT HE’S TALKIN’ ABOUT!
We’ve got to set the rules, this is ludicrous!

He’s goin’ for the man down the DSS look!
I like that look – no, it’s a nice look!
Have you got a single pair of trousers that aren’t elasticated at the waist.

Pringles. It's not the coolest one, is it? Pringles? I mean, even the name Pringles, really.
I know. It's sort of like an insult, isn't.

"Don't get enough of him. Do you?" Do you know what i mean?

That wouldn't be appropriate at all.

--old women saying "Uh, I heated this up in the microwave, I went to sleep - it split asunder and the blue gel scorched my legs. I've got third-degree burns." And would you know--

The leather cap, the jacket, the nappy.

"Hotel, yes, roof, good, food, adequate, beach, clean. Next."

Yeah it was just absurd. I had to kinda you know, scrabble around on the floor and thankfully they were ok, they didn’t get broken.

‘And you know you sent me that 30 quid for my birthday?’

It was like- you could tell she was clearly probably desperate for crack or her latest fix of smack. So she was literally- the normal etiquette of prostitution, you know they hang around, they show some thigh. I’ve seen this in films.

-And that's exersise... And then you sit at home and watch TV.

Okay? Let it warm up, pop inside for another cup of tea, come back out, it's lovely and warm and toasty in there. That's what I'd like to see them do with the old plane.

That’s why, that’s why they attacked him.
